name: Polyurethane foam moulding
summary: Two liquids react in a closed mould and swell into a soft foam. The foam takes the shape of the mould and keeps it.
how: Mix the polyol and the isocyanate with a blowing agent in the ratio of the supplier.
Pour the mix into the mould and close it before the foam rises.
Open the mould after the cure and pull out the foam body.
Trim the flash at the parting line and coat the body with a flexible paint or a fabric cover.

origin.note: Otto Bayer and his coworkers at IG Farben first make polyurethanes. Production of flexible polyurethane foam begins in 1954.

adoptions.via: Gufram shows its foam furniture, sold as Multipli, at the Milan Triennale.
